detail:
New decision "Chose to sort a copy of scoredItems by score before the presentation loop rather than re-merging the already-sorted warnings and nonWarnings arrays" relates to:
- 01KQ09TCGSFY75732ZAEN7WHZF: "Default tool surface is 5 core tools gated behind full_surface flag"
- 01KQ0VBWP8703Z0T675AZ1KHYS: "Prefer explicit Rationale:/Why:/Reason:/Because: markers over heuristic split separators in record-parser"
- 01KQ0VBWQPD1ND8SKA7TR2X04X: "Replaced split(regex, 2) with single-split-on-first-match that preserves the full remainder"
- 01KQ0VBWS51Z5B7B0FNFY3RDEN: "Added a structured union variant to twining_record's decisions field: each item is either a string (NL path) or an object { summary, rationale?, alternatives?, assumptions?, constraints?, confidence?, context?, domain? }. When structured, the parser is bypassed entirely, guaranteeing exact round-trip. Alternative rejected: separate twining_record_structured tool (doubles the tool surface, splits documentation). Alternative rejected: always-parse NL (cannot handle long multi-paragraph rationales reliably)."
- 01KQ0VBWWEXR62BG3MYGE79FB7: "Surfaced per-decision persistence errors in the twining_record response"
- 01KQWE98F42J3FJKQW1Q6T0PFF: "Staleness threshold is global-only (config.yml housekeeping.staleness_threshold, default 0.95). Per-decision sunset overrides not added"
- 01KQWF4YTD4ZZ0WKVV61V77KV6: "Used null sentinel from listLocalBranches() to distinguish 'enumeration failed' from 'legitimately empty branch set'"
- 01KWN4BCJVKH1X982JA0WDDS66: "Forward migrate refuses to run when config is sqlite with export_records explicitly false"
- 01KWNSPKV8AE6VH87QP1ZWG6NZ: "Auto-archive trigger counts only archivable entries (excludes decision cross-posts and archive-tagged summaries) and the archiver's summary post carries _skipAutoArchive"
- 01KWQD48ZPSMZZSQ34WNBK28TJ: "depends_on validation surfaces via an additive optional dropped_depends_on field on decide()'s existing return"
- 01KWX1P1K7Q36X8BJTGBFPVX49: "Chose to resolve priority_weights from the raw parsed YAML (parsed.context_assembly.priority_weights) rather than the deep-merged config"
- 01KWX1P1PVWY30FGEHF00QQE5D: "Chose to rewrite this repo's .twining/config.yml priority_weights as the five explicit default values (0.2/0.2/0.15/0.1/0.35) rather than keeping the four legacy values with an explicit graph_reachability: 0"
- 01KX4DQE0G2C7R4V018AD71GQ0: "Chose union-of-keys generic status-count comparison in the store's validation (countsMatch iterates the union of local and server decision-status keys)"
- 01KX4EAYYBAANEM1841W3938BV: "Preserved renderDecisions' hidden side effect (timeline refresh on fresh data) by moving it into fetchDecisions when deleting the function"
- 01KX4EAZ03B6QQWSMEMA18F5K8: "Reused app.js's renderDecisionDetail for the new list's detail panel via the classic-script window bridge instead of porting ~180 lines now"
- 01KX4FDYS595P096H4PCFEYPT6: "Overview meta-graph drops self-loop type edges (file→file etc.)"
- 01KX4NW8W4WTVKREQTRHNAP32M: "Deferred the Blackboard Stream view rework (still O(dataset) DOM)"
- 01KY11ZFEBD2A5XANFYGGSA476: "Chose to implement ranking/tiering entirely in DecisionEngine.why() rather than in the storage backends' getByScope"
- 01KY11ZFJVGGHZ58JFGE1MVBET: "Chose to cap the compact tier at 50 entries with omitted_count beyond"
- 01KY11ZFMN3PWRPZN1MFN9M3T1: "Chose ids-mode drill-down to bypass the budget and return richer detail (context, full alternatives, constraints, depends_on) than scope mode ever carried"
- 01KY15ZACMRJJCXW7RY8TVTWM7: "Chose to implement the exemption inside Archiver via a new pure plan() partition method"
- 01KY15ZAG0JYQ8E0ST949GGGCY: "Chose full-pipeline simulation for housekeeping preview (#39 option a: preview calls Archiver.plan() and filters downstream passes by the planned-archive set) over annotating preview"
- 01KY2SN8GKSMA6MQ7403JQMVR4: "Chose engine-level registry auto-touch via BlackboardEngine.touchAgent (setter-injected IAgentStore, reused by DecisionEngine through its blackboardEngine reference) over per-tool touches"
- 01KY72PJQJSY2K3QJPYZZAR241: "Chose input range-normalization inside buildTriage with unconstrained zod numerics at the tool"
- 01KY72PK2A3F1K556QW73QTXSC: "Made truncation selection contractual ((timestamp,id) oldest-open/newest-recent) independent of the advisory §4.2 ordering, and added counts.open.irreversible plus a normative dashboard truncation indicator so provisional irreversible decisions are truncation-proof."
- 01KY73F5JBZZG8Z6WC5K69KJZK: "Kept decision-store/sqlite getByScope affected_files matching on scopeMatches too (same bidirectional rule, pure function) while leaving affected_symbols as strict equality"
- 01KY73TDK005CN3KPAGMYW2MEB: "Applied defensive ?? '' on Decision.rationale and BlackboardEntry.detail before preview construction"
- 01KY87YQ6GG47BX6X5QVHPENSC: "Chose per-decision status on twining_record's structured objects with NL strings always active"
- 01KY89JXYG06GMPF7ADGCWN6DA: "Chose to include provisional entries in decide()'s conflict scan"
- 01KY89JY1PCDCAES2ZEJRFRV6Q: "Chose to exclude ids already in new_decisions from what_changed's reconsidered_decisions"
